usage:

evidence.reason: Left edit removes metering.initialize() and changes evaluate arguments from (units, 0.1, "monthly") to (units, 0, "benchmark"), altering the charge computation and dropping initialization that other code may rely on.
Right edit swaps priorities from [multiplier, multiplier/2] to [multiplier/2, multiplier], changing which term is subtracted in the return expression and thus the numeric result for all callers.
chargeUnit is the shared dependency linking subscriptionCharge and usageCharge; changes on either side propagate through this symbol, so the combined effect is not isolated.
Test only asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, which is too weak to detect the changed multiplier/plan semantics or the removed initialization.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动分别改变了订阅计费的初始化与参数、以及用量计费的优先级顺序，现有测试只验证正数结果，无法确认合并后行为是否仍符合预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts 的 subscriptionCharge 作者确认是否应保留 metering.initialize() 并明确 evaluate 的 multiplier 与 plan 取值；同时请 src/metering.ts 的 usageCharge 作者确认 priorities 顺序调整是否为有意变更，并补充覆盖具体数值的测试。
